title: Developing a Custom YOLOv8 Model for Number Detection on Meters Using FastAPI and Gradio
points: Annotates the meter dataset in Roboflow and trains YOLOv8 from it.
Trains across Kaggle's two TPUs with DataParallel.
Serves the weights twice: a containerized FastAPI endpoint, and a Gradio app on Hugging Face.

title: Simplify Your Log Management: Configuring DataDog Integration with Log4j2 In Mulesoft
points: A Log4j2 HTTP appender POSTs JSONLayout events straight to Datadog's Send Logs API.
No agent on the host, and no collector in between.
The appender is asynchronous, so logging never blocks a Mule execution thread.
